caption: The drawing depicts a standing human figure in profile view, facing left, with brown skin and dark brown hair. The figure is adorned with three large, light brown feathers on their head and wears a headband. They are dressed in a tunic that is light brown with darker brown outlines and a short skirt featuring horizontal dark brown stripes. Over the left shoulder and draped across the body is a red cloak. The figure holds a bundle of light green cigars in their right hand, close to the chest, and a rectangular board or sign in the left hand at thigh level, which bears the text “FINE CIGARS” in capital letters. The figure is standing on a gray rectangular base, and both feet are clad in light brown shoes. The background is plain with a beige hue, and there is a small, dark, looping signature or symbol in the lower right corner.
title: Cigar Store Indian
